svg.title: Scalar proximal maps at step γ = 1, λ = 1
svg.desc: Soft thresholding from NormL1 moves inputs of magnitude above one toward zero by one. Hard thresholding from NormL0 keeps inputs of magnitude above the square root of two and sets the rest to zero. Firm thresholding from MCP with a = 3 is zero up to magnitude one, steeper than the identity up to three and the identity beyond.

g.text: Scalar proximal maps at step γ = 1, λ = 1
